added.statement: Every floating flake input resolves to the newest revision at its existing declared ref, and the devbox uses the newest ast-grep package provided by the refreshed Nixpkgs inputs.
acceptance_criteria: flake.lock records the current revision for every floating input while preserving fixed refs and original input URLs
The Home Manager package selection resolves ast-grep from refreshed nixpkgs-unstable when stable nixpkgs is older
The cc-se-sto-devbox-01 evaluated profile selects the version from locked nixpkgs-unstable and its activation package builds
The current Home Manager profile evaluates without Zsh option-rename warnings.

ears.response: refresh all floating input locks and expose the newest Nixpkgs-provided ast-grep package

breaker.condition: A floating input remains on an older revision or the profile exposes an older ast-grep package than the refreshed Nixpkgs input

added.statement: The refreshed Home Manager module uses current Zsh option paths and preserves enabled autosuggestions and syntax highlighting without rename warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Home Manager evaluation emits no warnings for programs.zsh.enableAutosuggestions or programs.zsh.enableSyntaxHighlighting
The effective programs.zsh.autosuggestion.enable and programs.zsh.syntaxHighlighting.enable values are true
